items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Mud Carey on the trumpet... Johnny Dodds on clarinet, and Mud Carey on the cornet... That's what Mud told me. Only four pieces that you came up.

ctx.x: Johnny Dodds and- Well, that's what I wanted to hear about. Mud Carey told me he came up to Chicago with you.
Yes, yes. And the drummer was Little Mac, Mud Carey on the trumpet. What was his last name? Do you remember? I think his last name was Robinson, but did we call him? Robinson. Yes. Little Mac

Robinson. There was once a Mac Murray there. Yeah. And then I've heard of a Mac Hill that Lee Collins has told me about. It wouldn't be Mac Hill. Oh, no, no, no, no. I didn't know any of those fellas myself, personally. Well, they all were kids. But Roberts. You think it was Mac Robertson? I think
